defects.description: selectCaptureRange only unions the anchor-to-target span into the existing set, so a corrective shift-click on a nearer row never shrinks an overshot range and the bulk delete removes every overshot capture

toggleSelectAll derives its checked state from the visible rows but clears the whole store, and selectAllCaptures replaces the set, so under a filter they drop or act on selections the operator cannot see

Escape precedence over the command palette depends on listener registration order, and this child listener registers first, so on a deep-linked captures route Escape in the palette also wipes the selection
The row checkbox is always mounted and hidden only by opacity-0, so every row has an invisible tab stop that toggles batch selection on Space
